sources.label: 2010 SPP Doc. 202, Sec. 7.17 — Project Construction Cost: cost of completed building including structure, MEP, fixtures, systems; EXCLUDES architect's fee, engineer fees, specialist consultant fees, construction inspector salaries
sources.description: 2010 SPP Document 202, Section 7.17 (pp. 22-23). Defines PCC as total cost of labor, materials, equipment, contractor overhead. Market value applies if owner furnishes items below cost. Professional fees explicitly excluded. Source: Standards of Professional Practice2.pdf.

sources.label: 2010 SPP Document 202 — Standards of Professional Practice on Regular Design Services (Part of IRR of RA 9266, effective 09 March 2011)
sources.description: 2010 SPP Document 202 (pp. 12-23). Published in Official Gazette 21 Feb 2011. Contains project classification Groups 1-10, methods of compensation (Sec. 5.1-5.6), PCC definition (Sec. 7.17). Source: Standards of Professional Practice2.pdf.

sources.label: UAP Doc. 202 (1979) — Schedule of Minimum Basic Fee with sliding scale brackets
sources.description: 1979 UAP Document 202 (pp. 30-34). Fee schedule per project group with sliding scale. Source: 1979 UAP Documents.pdf.

sources.label: RA 9266 (2004) — The Architecture Act of 2004, Sec. 22: Architect's compensation based on percentage of construction cost or other mutually agreed basis
sources.description: Republic Act No. 9266, enacted March 17, 2004. Section 22 addresses architect's compensation. The UAP SPP Documents provide the standard fee schedule as part of the IRR.
